newsitem.title: USA: Citrus World Inc says recalls some juice products.
newsitem.headline: Citrus World Inc says recalls some juice products.

text.p: Citrus World Inc said Tuesday it is voluntarily recalling some of its pineapple juice products because they contain bacteria that occasionally cause nausea and upset stomachs.
The privately-held company said it believes a small quantity of its products are affected and it knows of two instances of minor illness associated with these products.
It has alerted the FDA and has taken steps since to make sure its pineapple juice products are free of the bacteria.
People who find a product with that label and product code should call Citrus World at 1-800-842-2017 or 1-800-654- 2119.
